thesis_title: [DOCUMENT FORMAT: Praca Inżynierska Politechniki Łódzkiej | thesis_type=inzynierska | template_name=thesis_plodz (ThesisPLodz.cls)] Research question: can a tabular Q-Learning agent learn to play Tic-Tac-Toe well against a uniformly random opponent, and how does its play compare with that baseline? Design the experiment yourself: choose the parameters, training or search budget, number of repetitions and seeds, the metrics you will report and the success criterion, and declare the metrics and the experiment entrypoint in the plan before running anything. Implement the solution as small, single-purpose modules with unit tests, produce every result by running the declared entrypoint, and write the thesis so that every reported number is a symbolic pointer to the code or to a results file.
